extDescription.message: Select text on a page and an LLM explains it in context in the side panel. Highlights and cards stay linked, and notes come back in place next time.

actionTitle.message: Open the Reading Notes side panel

errOpenPdfFirst.message: Open an online or local PDF first.

errPdfPage.message: Couldn't recognise the PDF reader page.

errWaitNote.message: Wait for the note to finish before asking.

errAskBusy.message: The previous question is still being answered.

selectFirst.message: Select some text on the page first.

noTextSelected.message: There's no text in the selection.

selectionTooLong.message: The selection is too long (limit: $1 characters).

noResponsePdf.message: The extension isn't responding. Reload the extension and the document.

staleReload.message: Reading Notes was updated. Reload the page to keep using it.

errNoKey.message: No API key yet. Add one in Settings.

errNoModel.message: No model name yet. Add one in Settings.

errRefused.message: The model refused this request$1. Try another model or a different selection.

truncated.message: (The answer hit the length limit and was cut off.)

errAllModels.message:
None of the candidate models is available right now:
$1

errGeminiBlocked.message: Gemini's safety filter blocked the request ($1).

errNetworkHint.message: Network request failed: $1 (check the network or proxy, and the Base URL)

keyBanner.message: No API key yet, so notes can't be written.

pdfBanner.message: If this is a PDF, open it in the annotation reader.

emptyTitle.message: No notes on this page yet

emptyStep1.message: Click an English word, or select a phrase or sentence on the page or PDF

emptyStep2.message: Click the Annotate button that appears, press Alt+Shift+A, or right-click → Annotate

emptyStep3.message: The model gives a Chinese equivalent from the whole paragraph, with a folded detailed explanation; each card lines up with its word

unsupportedTitle.message: Notes aren't available on this page

unsupportedWhy.message: Browser pages and the Web Store can't be annotated. For PDFs, use this extension's PDF reader.

unsupportedFile.message: For local files, turn on “Allow access to file URLs” for this extension in chrome://extensions.

explainTitle.message: Ask the model to explain the selected part of the note

explainAsk.message: Please explain “$1”, which you mentioned above.

answerInterrupted.message: The answer was interrupted (the extension may have restarted).

askPlaceholder.message: Ask more, e.g. a more casual translation? What does “it” refer to here?

askBusyHint.message: Wait for this answer before asking more

askKeysHint.message: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to close

orphan.message: Couldn't find the original text on this page

generatingNote.message: Writing the note from the context…

genInterrupted.message: Writing was interrupted (the extension may have restarted).

askLocked.message: You can ask once the note is ready

optionsLead.message: Settings stay in this browser on this computer (chrome.storage.local). They aren't synced, and nothing is sent anywhere except the API you enter.

providerOpenai.message: OpenAI-compatible API (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, OpenRouter, local models…)

effortLow.message: low: fastest, fine for everyday words and long sentences (recommended)

effortMedium.message: medium: more careful, for writing full of irony and allusions

effortDefault.message: Don't send; use the model's default

notePromptSub.message: First note: a short Chinese equivalent + a folded detailed explanation

notePromptHint.message: Requests include the page title, the URL, the whole paragraph around the selection (<paragraph>) and the selection (<selection>). The output format (the IPA line and the 【详解】 separator) is added automatically; don't write it here.

followPromptSub.message: Follow-up questions and “Explain this” on cards

followPromptHint.message: For follow-ups the model sees the paragraph, the first note (with its detailed explanation) and all earlier questions and answers.

ipaHint.message: For words, phrases and names of up to 6 words, the model gives the IPA as read in that passage. It appears after the word on the card and when you hover over the highlight. Regenerate older notes to add it.

floatingButtonLabel.message: Show the floating “Annotate” button next to selected text

clickToAnnotateLabel.message: Click an English word to annotate it; click an annotated word to jump to its note (double and triple clicks still select text)

shortcutHint.message: You can also press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> or use the right-click menu. Change the shortcut at

baseHintGemini.message: Leave empty for the official https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com. The browser uses the system proxy; where Google is blocked, keep the proxy on.

baseHintAnthropic.message: Leave empty for the official https://api.anthropic.com. For a relay or proxy, enter its address (without /v1/messages).

baseHintOpenai.message: Up to /v1, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1.

keyPlaceholderGemini.message: Paste the key, or the whole curl command from AI Studio

modelHintGemini.message: auto (recommended): tries the newest Flash models first and moves on when one is overloaded, rate-limited or slow, checking in the background when a better one is back. A specific model also switches to another when it's unavailable.

modelHintAnthropic.message: claude-opus-5-5 gives the best quality; claude-sonnet-5-5 is faster and cheaper; claude-haiku-5-5 is the cheapest.

modelHintOpenai.message: Use the model name from the provider's docs, e.g. deepseek-chat.

connOk.message: Connected · $1 replied: “$2” (remember to Save if you haven't)

imported.message: Imported $1 notes (ones already here are skipped)

pdfOpenFailed.message: Couldn't open the PDF: $1. You can pick a local PDF with “Open file”.

noTextLayer.message: No selectable text on this page (scans need OCR)

samePage.message: Select text within one page (it can span lines).

selectPdfFirst.message: Select a word, phrase or sentence in the PDF first.

stillLoading.message: The document is still loading. Try again in a moment.

reselect.message: The page was redrawn. Please select the text again.

needsPassword.message: This PDF needs a password. Unlock it in the browser's reader first.

storageError.message: Couldn't read the stored notes. Reload the extension.

pickFile.message: Click “Open file” to pick a PDF, then select text to annotate it.

onlyHttp.message: Only http, https and local file addresses are supported
